title: Great bags but the price could be a bit lower.
text: Great bags but the price could be a bit lower.. I love my food saver!  These bags are great!  I rarely have a bag lose it's vacuum seal.  It does happen on occasion and I'm not sure why but most of the bags keep the vacuum.  I store a lot of items in these bags.  I much prefer them to zip-lock.  I do feel the cost could be a bit lower.
